A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have shown that the PI-based HAART regimens are associated with an increase of the serum levels of triglycerides and FFAs and that the PI-based regimens are also associated with a significant decrease in serum levels of HDL-cholesterol.
we have shown that PI therapy is associated with a reduction of insulin sensitivity in HIV-infected patients, which is not related to changes in body fat distribution.
the use of protease inhibitor-based regimens is associated with a significant increase in the prevalence of dyslipidemia and the incidence of diabetes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we need to be more vigilant about the potential metabolic side effects of antiretrovirus therapy.
